name: insert-node-admission-limits
body: A location-less FQN repeated still panics with `<no source>` on both sides (Module, Language, spec/plan/Scan nodes), and the same-source dedupe requires equal kind, so a same-path cross-kind repeat still panics. Upgrade only if a location-less identity ever needs idempotent admission, or a frontend can stream two kinds from one file at one FQN.
